ko.title: 야옹 고양이, 멍멍 강아지 🐱🐶 | 따라 부르는 동물 동요 | 모모타임
ko.description:
모모와 고양이, 강아지를 만나 보아요!
야옹, 고양이! 멍멍, 강아지! 짧은 후렴을 따라 부르고 신나는 리듬에 몸을 흔들어 보세요.

2~4세 아이들을 위한 한국어 동요. 오늘의 두 단어: 고양이 · 강아지.

#모모타임 #동물동요 #고양이 #강아지 #유아동요 #따라부르기

notes.v_over_reason: 34 playback cuts reuse six approved sources; no new Higgsfield jobs. New cue timings follow replacement audio. No lip sync or freeze extension.
next_time: Use accepted audio recordings as actual musical references. This replacement is agent-selected; do not label it user-approved unless the user later says so.
Keep two target words within melodic phrases. Automated scores do not establish musical enjoyment.
notes.standing_authorization: agent review and public upload; normal one-credit download

selected_song.reference_comparison: C2 groove, rounded bass, rhythm guitar and feminine sung phrasing retained;114.3BPM versus113.8 source. Both v1 adaptations from cat/dog source had rushed/chopped phrasing and were not selected. v2 take2 selected for continuous flowing phrasing and no long middle gap. Final lyric completion to check independently.

alignment_review.method: Phrase-level video cue timing, not word-level karaoke. Official timestamps reconciled with independent ASR, repeated musical sections and vocal-stem inspection; whole-phrase tokens deliberately used because only two keyword labels are rendered.
limitations: Independent ASR confuses repeated sound words; its match percentage is not a music-quality or comprehension score.
Automated listening describes arrangement but does not establish user satisfaction.
